capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: mbusa lists "battery capacity 90.6 kWh" without a gross/usable label and no second page labelling this pack was found; read as usable by analogy with the sibling packs whose usable figure is labelled (EQS 107.8, EQE 90.6, EQS 118). Read on the 2025 AMGEQEX4 page (no page opened for this exact trim/year); same pack and charger on the sibling trim.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Wikipedia EQE table: EQE 350+ and EQE 300 both 100 kWh gross (usable 90.6 / 89); not applied to the 90.5 / 96 kWh cars.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia infobox lists NCM 811 for this model (uncited there).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia infobox lists a 400 V system for this model (EQS 400V; EQE 400V / 328 V); uncited there.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: the Mercedes USA EQE/EQS quick-start guide says (per the fact-checker excerpt; the PDF could not be read here) the battery is prepared automatically before the charging station is reached, i.e. a navigation trigger; same system on sedan and SUV. Whether a separate manual battery control exists is unproven either way (the mbusa EV FAQ mentions on-demand preconditioning from the app, possibly cabin only).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: sibling page lists 170 kW for the same pack and charger (2025 AMGEQEX4); this car's own page was not opened.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: sibling page lists 9.6 kW AC.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: sibling page lists 32 min 10-80 % for the same pack.
